news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: Revenues exceed analysts expectations while EPS lags behind
news.body: Full year 2026 results: ₹3.28 loss per share (down from ₹0.99 profit in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹51.0b (up 10% from FY 2025). Net loss: ₹360.9m (down 431% from profit in FY 2025). Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 1.9%. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates. Revenue is forecast to grow 4.7% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 8.3% growth forecast for the Multiline Retail industry in Asia. Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 72 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.
